about.heading: Engineering precision in service of global maritime trade.
about.intro: German Naval Logistics was founded to provide shipping companies and fleet operators with a dedicated, technically proficient procurement partner.

story.heading: Our Perspective
story.paragraph1: Commercial shipping operates under extreme schedule and cost pressure. Every port stay is measured in hours, and unexpected machinery failure disrupts complex global logistics chains. German Naval Logistics was built to eliminate this friction.
story.paragraph2: We do not operate as mere brokers; we act as technical problem-solvers. Headquartered in Hamburg with an established network of manufacturers, stocking locations, and forwarders, we ensure that the correct part arrives in exact condition when and where required.

items.title: Uncompromising Fit & Spec
items.description: We verify part numbers and drawings through multi-tier verification before any component is dispatched. Preventing errors takes precedence over reckless speed.

items.title: Firm Reliability
items.description: We only commit to timelines we can honor. Honest, transparent communication regarding lead times and inventory is the cornerstone of client trust.

items.title: Certified Quality Control
items.description: All parts originate from accredited manufacturers and are shipped with factory test certificates and class society documentation.

approach.heading: Our Approach
approach.description: We combine traditional Hanseatic trade dependability with modern, digitized supply chain monitoring. Our clients value speaking directly with technical engineers who know marine machinery intimately and understand the urgent realities of life at sea.

location.heading: Strategic Logistics Headquarters
location.description: From our base in Essen, we coordinate express road freight to major European ports (Rotterdam, Antwerp, Hamburg, Bremerhaven) and international air/ocean shipments to maritime hubs worldwide.
location.mapAlt: Overview map of the Essen logistics facility

services.heading: Comprehensive Marine Spare Parts & Logistics.
services.intro: We support technical superintendents and fleet managers with end-to-end parts procurement, quality certification, and timely on-board delivery.

items.title: Marine Machinery & Engine Spare Parts
items.description: Supply of genuine OEM parts and certified alternatives for all critical shipboard machinery.
bullets: Main and auxiliary diesel engine parts (pistons, cylinder liners, valves, injection equipment)
Pumps, compressors, and centrifugal separators for lub-oil, fuel, and ballast water
Deck machinery, windlasses, mooring winches, and cargo crane spares
Hydraulic power units, actuators, steering gear valves, and high-pressure hoses
Filtration elements, mechanical seal kits, and standardized consumables

items.title: Rapid Sourcing & Hard-to-Find Components
items.description: Specialized sourcing for obsolete, out-of-production, or emergency shipboard components.
bullets: Access to global surplus inventories and certified surplus channels
Technical evaluation and substitution of obsolete parts with class-approved equivalents
Fast-track bespoke machining based on original technical drawings or physical samples
Direct procurement from original equipment makers with minimum turnaround

items.title: Global Port & On-Board Delivery
items.description: Synchronized logistics bringing spare parts directly to the ship's gangway worldwide.
bullets: Active coordination with port agents, stevedores, and local harbor authorities
Consolidation of multi-vendor consignments in bonded warehouses
Full customs clearance (transit customs, ship stores declarations, T1 documents)
Certified handling of dangerous goods, batteries, and temperature-sensitive parts

items.title: Quality Assurance & Class Documentation
items.description: Rigorous multi-stage inspection and documentation before any cargo leaves our care.
bullets: Compliance with leading IACS classification societies (DNV, LR, BV, ABS)
Material test certificates according to EN 10204 / 3.1 and 3.2 standards
Incoming dimensional and visual verification with photographic evidence
Complete batch and heat traceability for all safety-critical components

items.title: Fleet Supply Framework Agreements
items.description: Long-term partnership contracts designed to optimize budgets and ensure stock readiness.
bullets: Fixed pricing agreements and dedicated safety stock reservations for critical parts
Dedicated technical account superintendent assigned to your fleet
Vessel consumption auditing and onboard minimum inventory recommendations
Priority processing in emergency breakdown scenarios

items.title: 24/7 Emergency Breakdown Dispatch (AOG)
items.description: Immediate intervention when vessels are immobilized, minimizing expensive port layover fees.
bullets: 24/7 manned emergency technical operations desk
Immediate deployment of On-Board Couriers (OBC) and dedicated air charters
Priority customs fast-tracking for urgent ship spares in transit
Real-time GPS tracking until confirmed receipt by the Chief Engineer

items.question: What are typical lead times for marine spare parts?
items.answer: Lead times vary by component type and availability. Critical consumables and standard parts held in European warehouses can be delivered within 24 to 48 hours to major European ports. For bespoke OEM parts or specialized castings, we confirm reliable dispatch dates immediately upon inquiry.

items.question: Do you provide only OEM parts or also certified aftermarket alternatives?
items.answer: We align strictly with the technical requirements of the shipowner. By default, we source original OEM components. Upon request, we also provide vetted, certified alternative parts from reputable European manufacturers, with transparent disclosure of origin and specification.

items.question: Which classification certificates can you supply with the parts?
items.answer: Depending on part classification requirements, we supply components certified by major IACS classification societies, including DNV, Lloyd's Register, Bureau Veritas, and ABS, along with EN 10204 3.1 or 3.2 inspection certificates.

items.question: How is order coordination handled at the destination port?
items.answer: Once an order is approved, our operations desk liaises directly with your nominated local ship agent. We handle customs declarations, track the vessel's ETA, and ensure hand-over at the gangway prior to sailing.

items.question: Which global ports and geographic regions do you cover?
items.answer: Our core ground network seamlessly serves all European seaports. In addition, we coordinate international air and ocean cargo to all major maritime hubs across Asia, the Americas, and the Middle East.
